data.title: 冬马和纱 · 谱页上的铅笔线
data.description: 和纱停下练习，在谱页上用铅笔划出一个小节，目光仍停在那几行音符上。
data.action: seated at a piano, marking a score with a pencil
data.promptProse: Seated on an adjustable leather piano bench in a soundproofed practice room, Kazusa leans over the music rest with a sharp mechanical pencil, drawing an emphatic bracket around a difficult cadenza measure. Slanting late-afternoon sunlight catches the glossy ebony piano lid and her focused, furrowed brow as eraser crumbs gather on the score.
